bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to education; clarifying evidence-based education grant goals; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 127A.20, subdivision 2.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 127A.20, subdivision 2, is amended to read:

Subd. 2.
Goals.
Each applicant for a grant awarded by the commissioner of education must include in the grant application a statement of the goals of the education program and grant funds. To the extent practicable, the goals must be aligned to the state of Minnesota's [-world's best workforce-][+ comprehensive achievement and civic readiness+] and the federally required Every Student Succeeds Act accountability systems.

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective July 1, 2025. +]

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 127A.20, subdivision 2, is amended to read:

Goals.
